nonclaims: controlled synthetic power repair only; no G/H confirmation forecast read
repair nomination is not fresh validation or predictive equivalence
no posterior truth, sampler ranking, model adequacy, or default claim
1984 draws are a feasibility arm and do not authorize HMC acquisition
skew and dependence families remain explanatory

sequential_stopping.reason: all arm/tolerance candidates are unable to meet the frozen 20-replication thresholds
sequential_stopping.rule: stop only when no arm/tolerance can meet every frozen threshold after assigning all remaining outcomes favorably

synthetic_validity.arm_independence: left and right use distinct Philox fold-in domains 11 and 22
synthetic_validity.candidate_fairness: B/C/D reuse the same generated paths, estimates, covariance, Bonferroni interval, and MMD interval within each family/replication
synthetic_validity.draw_mixing: all configured absolute phi values are strictly below one
synthetic_validity.draw_stationarity: initial Gaussian cluster drawn from invariant N(0,R); AR recursion uses sqrt(1-phi^2)
synthetic_validity.marginal_standardization: cluster/replication mixture variances sum to one
